## Assumptions
- Usable roof fraction 0.45–0.6 [E162]
- Watts per usable square foot 12.0 [E162]
- Installed cost $2.0 [E162] per watt
- Electricity price $0.22 [E162] per kWh
- Tilt 10 [E162] degrees
- Azimuth 180 [E162] degrees
- System losses 14 [E162] percent

## Caveats
- Simple payback ignores incentives, financing, tax credits, demand charges, O&M costs and degradation [E162]
- Roof area is measured from aerial imagery and may include roof areas that cannot hold panels [E162]

- No buildings were skipped for missing roof area measurements [E162]

**Rooftop solar** (estimated): 364.7 [E163] kW, 591,120 [E163] kWh/yr, 5.6 [E163] year payback

**LED lighting** (not estimated): needs a lighting fixture inventory, wattage and operating hours

**Window film** (not estimated): needs glazing area, orientation and cooling load; top-down imagery does not show facades

**HVAC upgrade** (not estimated): needs equipment type, age and efficiency data
